instruction: I have a text file named "notes_draft.txt" on the Desktop. Please rename it to "notes_final.txt".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming a file from notes_draft.txt to notes_final.txt. Evaluator checks if the renamed file exists using shell command. Similar difficulty to original (single file operation). Uses existing exact_match metric and vm_command_line getter, no custom functions needed.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements of a rename operation: (1) new file 'notes_final.txt' exists, AND (2) old file 'notes_draft.txt' does NOT exist
Command uses logical AND (&&) to ensure both conditions must be true for success: [ -f ~/Desktop/notes_final.txt ] && [ ! -f ~/Desktop/notes_draft.txt ]
Evaluator can correctly distinguish between rename (pass), copy (fail - both files exist), and create new file (fail - old file still exists)
Expected value 'Rename successful\n' correctly matches the success output when both conditions are met
The evaluator logic is semantically sound and will correctly verify the instruction at runtime
